dataset: dHCP fetal atlas GW21-GW36, clean parcellation rescaled to true brain size
label_legend_note: Point this at 'info/dhcp-atlas-summary-info-19-labels.csv' inside your copy of the dHCP atlas download (an equivalent ITK-SnAP .txt sits beside it). Left empty here because its location depends on where you unpacked the atlas.
label_selection_note: Cerebrum excluding cortex, matching what the fetal_surface runs measured (white-matter boundary). Kept: 5,6 Fetal WM L/R; 7,8 Lateral Ventricle L/R; 9 Cavum septum pellucidum; 14,15 Basal Ganglia L/R; 16,17 Thalamus L/R; 18 Third Ventricle. Dropped: 1,2 eCSF; 3,4 Cortical GM; 10 Brainstem; 11,12 Cerebellum; 13 Vermis; 19 Fourth Ventricle.
method_note: batch_dir must be the root written by scripts/rescale_atlas_to_true_size.py. Labels come from parcellations_scaled, which is clean (one connected component per structure); size comes from parcellations_orig_size, measured as the per-axis bounding-box ratio of a debris-free brain mask. Resampling is nearest-neighbour about the brain centre, so no label id is ever averaged. Dice against the orig_size brain is 0.9898 at GW21 rising to 0.9965 at GW32; extents match exactly.
why_note: parcellations_orig_size is a badly nearest-neighbour-warped parcellation: at GW36 it holds 66,413 connected components across 12 labels, 63,305 of them 8 voxels or smaller against only 12 larger than 1000, an isolated-voxel rate of 35-65 per mille on every week versus 0.03-0.10 in parcellations_scaled, and 3,265 interior background hole components against 22. Those are the visible dots and white lines. The small midline structures are shattered and volume-inflated 1.7-2.7x - cavum septum pellucidum arrives as 2,833 pieces whose largest holds 35.7% of its volume. Filtering does not fix it: a 3x3x3 majority vote costs CSP 45.7%, third ventricle 34.7% and lateral ventricle L 20.5%, and speck-removal still drifts CSP 41-53% at every threshold, because about 64% of its voxels genuinely are specks.
interpretation_note: Shape is the scaled atlas's, size is the original-size atlas's. Report both facts alongside any number from this root. All 16 weeks are present. GW27/GW28 are NOT degraded here - their defect was confined to parcellations_orig_size, and the labels used here come from the clean scaled volumes. Do not mix this root with a raw parcellations_orig_size run in one workbook.
paths_note: batch_dir/batch_out are machine-specific and deliberately empty here. Copy this file to configs/area_band_config_dhcp_atlas_truesize.json (gitignored) and fill them in, or pass --batch-dir/--batch-out on the command line.
